name: Bootstrap (soft)
tagline: Interpolates the (poisoned) one-hot label with the model's own detached softmax prediction; trains on the mixed target.

key_hyperparams.name: $\beta$
key_hyperparams.role: weight on the noisy one-hot label

diff_from_baseline: Reed et al., ICLR 2015 ('Training Deep Neural Networks on Noisy Labels with Bootstrapping'). Soft-bootstrap variant; classic noise-robust loss.

name: Cross-Entropy
tagline: Standard categorical cross-entropy on the (possibly poisoned) labels — non-robust reference.
diff_from_baseline: Standard supervised cross-entropy. Susceptible to memorization under label noise; serves as the no-defense reference baseline.

name: Generalized Cross-Entropy (GCE)
tagline: Box-Cox-style generalization of CE that becomes more like MAE for small q, providing noise-robust gradients.

key_hyperparams.name: $q$
key_hyperparams.role: Box-Cox interpolation between CE ($q\to 0$) and MAE ($q=1$)

diff_from_baseline: Zhang & Sabuncu, NeurIPS 2018 ('Generalized Cross Entropy Loss for Training Deep Neural Networks with Noisy Labels'). Standard noise-robust loss baseline.

name: Symmetric Cross-Entropy (SCE)
tagline: CE plus a Reverse-CE penalty that swaps prediction and target arguments; alpha*CE + beta*RCE.
diff_from_baseline: Wang et al., ICCV 2019 ('Symmetric Cross Entropy for Robust Learning with Noisy Labels'). RCE penalizes confident wrong predictions and is theoretically noise-tolerant.
